column3: Manifest v3 keeps api 1 and accepts that a third-party code package injecting a guarded service without declaring its permission stops mounting
column4: api is the hard compatibility axis, but no third-party code package is in package.json today and bumping it would make every shipped manifest restate api 2 for no reader; the failure names the missing permission, so the fix for an author is one line
